fields.Front: What are the four assessments in CS3307A and their weights?
fields.Back: Project Proposal 20%, Intermediate Design and Partial Implementation 30%, Final Project Submission 30%, Final Examination 20%.

fields.Front: When is the CS3307A Project Proposal due?
When is the Intermediate Design and Partial Implementation due?
When is the Final Project Submission due?
When is the CS3307A final exam period?

fields.Text: Each CS3307A project deliverable has an automatic {{c1::48-hour}} no-late-penalty period after the deadline.
fields.Extra: It is not a replacement due date; after it closes you need approved Academic Consideration.

fields.Text: The CS3307A project is worth {{c1::80%}} of the grade and must be completed in {{c2::pairs of two students}}.

fields.Back: Problem Statement, System Features, Design Approach, Initial UML Class Diagram.

fields.Front: What must Deliverable 2 (Intermediate Design and Partial Implementation) contain?
fields.Back: Complete UML Diagrams, Use Case Descriptions, Partial Implementation in C++, Design Rationale Document.
Complete System Implementation, Final UML Diagrams, Comprehensive Documentation.

fields.Front: In what format must UML diagrams be submitted, and through which platforms are deliverables submitted?
fields.Back: PDF format; through Brightspace and GitHub.

fields.Front: What question types are on the CS3307A final exam, and what does the instructor emphasize?
fields.Back: Mix of multiple-choice, short answer, and problem-solving; 'lots and lots of refactoring' and writing code by hand.

fields.Front: Which testing frameworks does CS3307A use?
Is generative AI allowed in CS3307A?
fields.Back: Permitted with disclosure for project work; strictly prohibited on the final examination.

fields.Front: Who teaches CS3307A and what is their research area?
fields.Back: Dr. Umair Rehman, Director of the Human-Centered Computing Group; human-centered AI, games, human-computer interaction.

fields.Text: CS3307A has no Tuesday/Thursday classes during Fall Reading Week, October {{c1::13}} and October {{c2::15}}, 2026.
